name: repro-log
description: Keeps a reproducibility recipe for data work: the analysis commands that succeeded and the files you changed. /repro writes it to .moddeck/repro/ with git commit, versions, lock files, seeds and a runnable command list. Secrets are never written.

enabled.title: Enable repro-log
enabled.description: Turn off to record nothing and make /repro do nothing.

programs.title: Programs that count as analysis runs
programs.description: Comma list. A command is recorded when it succeeds and starts with one of these (two words such as 'cargo run' or 'R CMD' are allowed).

maxSteps.title: Most steps kept
maxSteps.description: Only the last this many steps are kept per project.
